purpose: Teach: 増員/測る/オーブン/カルテ/当番/仕上げる/仕切り/引き換え

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.en: We need to increase staff at the stores. It's urgent.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. No wasted breath. The tone of someone who has already thought this through and is moving forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の声、データで測る試み、進めます。
lines.en: Yes. We're moving ahead with the customer feedback data measurement trial.
lines.style: Steady, responsive. Slight lean forward—showing he's tracking and ready. No hesitation. Professional but not stiff; the ease of someone who works well with this person.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業務用オーブン、メンテナンス、出してね。
lines.en: Get the commercial oven in for maintenance.
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact. Sharp attack on the opening. No inflation. The businesslike tone of delegating something important without needing to explain why.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。顧客カルテ、CRMに統合中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're integrating the customer records into the CRM system now.
lines.style: Straightforward update. Calm tempo. A small note of progress in the voice—he's showing forward motion without overselling it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 清掃の当番表、新月で更新を。
lines.en: Update the cleaning schedule at the start of next month.
lines.style: Clean, instructional. Brisk but not rushed. The tone of someone delegating routine work with clarity—no ambiguity in what's needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。看板を仕上げる時期、近いです。
lines.en: Yes. The signboard work is coming up soon.
lines.style: Light uptick at the end. Small note of positive momentum. Responsive tone—not just confirming, but showing he's ahead on the details.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業務の仕切り、後輩に任せてみよう。
lines.en: Let's start handing off workflow coordination to the junior staff.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause underneath. Purposeful tone—this is a decision, not a task. Slight warmth, like she's considering their growth. Measured delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。引き換えポイント、顧客に説明します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll explain the redemption points system to the customers.
lines.style: Warm close. Responsive and assured—he's signaling he understands the endpoint of the conversation. Professional but human. Small sense of care in the delivery.
